title: First Aid Fail - The Office US

lines.en: So assessing the situation. Are they breathing?
lines.ko: 자, 상황 파악부터 합니다. 숨을 쉬나요?

lines.en: No, Rose, they are not breathing.
And they have no arms or legs.
No, that's not part of it.
Where are they?
You know what, if we come across somebody with no arms or legs
do we bother resuscitating them?
I mean, what kind of quality of life do we have there?
I would wanna live with no legs.
lines.ko: 난 다리 없이는 살기 싫을 것 같은데.

lines.en: How about no arms?
No arms or legs is basically how you exist right now, Kevin.
lines.ko: 팔다리 없는 거나 다름없죠, 지금 케빈 당신이.

lines.en: You don't do anything.
Alright, well let's get back to it, 'cause you're losing him.
lines.ko: 자, 다시 하죠. 환자를 놓치고 있어요.

lines.en: Okay, too fast. Everyone, we need to pump at a pace of 100 beats per minute.
lines.ko: 너무 빨라요. 여러분, 분당 100회 속도로 눌러야 해요.

lines.en: [sigh] Uhh, okay. That's hard to keep track.
How many is that per hour?
How's that gonna help you?
I will divide and then count to it.
Right.
Okay, well a good trick is to pump to the tune of "Stayin' Alive" by the Bee Gees.
lines.ko: 좋은 요령이 있어요. 비지스의 'Stayin' Alive' 박자에 맞춰 누르세요.

lines.en: Do you know that song?
Yes! Yes, I do. I love that song.
[clears throat]
♫ First I was afraid, I was petrified ♫
No, it's...
♫ Ah ah ah ah ♫
♫ Stayin' alive, stayin alive. ♫ - Okay, gotcha.
You were in the parking lot earlier! That's how I know you!
lines.ko: 아까 주차장에 계셨죠! 그래서 아는 얼굴이었네!

lines.en: ♫ Ah ah ah ah ♫
♫ Stayin' alive, Stayin' alive ♫
[Harmonizing] ♫ Ah-ah-ah-ah ♫
♫ Stayin' alive, stayin' alive ♫
♫ Ah, you can tell by the way I use my walk ♫
lines.ko: ♫ 아, 내 걸음걸이만 봐도 알 수 있지 ♫

lines.en: ♫ I'm a woman's man, no time to talk ♫
lines.ko: ♫ 난 여자들한테 인기 많은 남자, 얘기할 시간 없어 ♫

lines.en: ♫ Music loud and women warm, been kicked around since I was born ♫
lines.ko: ♫ 음악은 크게, 여자는 따뜻하게, 태어날 때부터 치이며 살았지 ♫

lines.en: ♫ Well, it's alright, it's okay, you can look the other way ♫
lines.ko: ♫ 괜찮아, 괜찮아, 못 본 척해도 돼 ♫

lines.en: ♫ Rit dit doo, rit dit doo ♫ [others harmonizing]
lines.ko: ♫ 릿 딧 두, 릿 딧 두 ♫ [다른 사람들 화음]

lines.en: Okay, okay!
Okay!
[Michael muttering lyrics]
♫ Stayin' alive, Stayin' alive. ♫
Yeah, okay. You didn't maintain 100 beats per minute,
lines.ko: 네, 좋아요. 분당 100회를 유지 못 했고

lines.en: and the ambulance didn't arrive because nobody called 911.
lines.ko: 아무도 911에 전화 안 해서 구급차도 안 왔네요.

lines.en: So, you lost 'em.
Okay, he's dead.
Anyone know what we do next? Anybody?
lines.ko: 다음엔 뭘 해야 하는지 아는 분? 아무나?

lines.en: Rose?
... I have no idea.
Anyone else?
We bury him.
Wrong. [makes buzzer sound]
Check for an organ donor card. If he has one, we only have minutes to harvest.
lines.ko: 장기 기증 카드를 확인하세요. 있으면 장기 적출까지 몇 분밖에 없어요.

lines.en: He has no wallet, I checked.
He is an organ donor.
He is?
-Yep. - Give me some ice in a styrofoam bucket!
Here we go.
[grunts]
Angela: Oh my god! [others groaning]
Dwight! Kelly: Dwight, what are you --
[Dwight yelling]
We search for the organs. Where's the heart, the precious heart?
lines.ko: 장기를 찾아야죠. 심장이 어디 있죠, 그 소중한 심장이?

lines.en: I'm not feeling well. I need to sit down.
[comforting Stanley] Hey Stanley, are you okay?
[suckering noise]
[Angela shrieks]
Stanley: Oh My God. Dwight!
"Clarisse."
[everyone groans]
Can you tell me why you had to cut the face off the dummy?
lines.ko: 인형 얼굴을 왜 잘라야 했는지 말해 줄래요?

lines.en: I didn't think it was very realistic in the movie.
lines.ko: 영화에서 보니까 별로 현실감이 없어 보여서요.

lines.en: It turns out... It's pretty realistic.
We had to pay for it. Cost us 3,500 dollars.
5,300 dollars for a dummy? Wow...
Well, okay. Look.
David, this is why we have training.
lines.ko: 데이비드, 그래서 우리가 교육을 하는 겁니다.

lines.en: We start with the dummy... and we learn from our mistakes...
and now Dwight knows not to cut the face off a real person.
lines.ko: 이제 드와이트도 산 사람 얼굴은 자르면 안 된다는 걸 알았잖아요.
